actualReturnedReportText:
batch122
Snapshot: candidate 7876a7f; frozen EN 6af98cb; accepted RU bfdd5ea; 2376 candidate objects, 2366 accepted baseline; both gates passed; five new strokes raw-identical.
Scope: all specified guidance/rubrics, 23 EN/RU teaching bodies, 82 official evidence items plus header, 434 typed metadata rows, 15 proposals, 5 adjudications, 5 clarifications, 5 overlap records, and 2 navigation diffs read completely; no failed or unread windows; no web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN: The five lessons preserve source facts and official evidence for readings, strokes, radicals, meanings, examples, compounds, attributed history, and explicitly modern mnemonics.
C2 FINDING: navigation diffs are wrapper-only and relative targets are correct, but three new lessons contain links to absent Russian word pages; see Findings. Distractor directions are individually acceptable as introductory/source-core comparisons, with no confirmed unsafe negative pair in the bounded evidence.
C3 FINDING: Russian learner text is generally comprehensible and natural, but dangling word links in three lessons reduce navigability and learner confidence.
N001望→服 S-intro: distinct title, readings, and ordinary meanings; supported as source-core shape comparison, not a blanket guard approval.
N002望→朝 S-intro: distinct hope/desire versus morning meanings and readings; source-core comparison supported.
N003望→青 S-intro: distinct hope versus blue/green meanings and readings; contour comparison supported.
N004未→末 S-intro: distinct not-yet versus end/tip meanings and readings despite near-identical shape; judge independently.
N005未→本 S-intro: distinct not-yet versus book/origin meanings and readings; 木-derived shape comparison supported.
N006未→木 S-intro: distinct not-yet versus tree/wood meanings and readings; contained-shape comparison supported.
N007末→未 S-intro: distinct end/tip versus not-yet meanings and readings; reciprocal edge judged independently.
N008末→本 S-intro: distinct end/tip versus book/origin meanings; 本末 antonym contact does not make the answer equivalent.
N009末→木 S-intro: distinct end/tip versus tree/wood meanings and readings; contained-shape comparison supported.
N010束→東 S-intro: distinct bundle versus east meanings and readings; contour comparison supported.
N011束→来 S-intro: distinct bundle/promise versus come meanings and readings; 木-derived shape comparison supported.
N012束→本 S-intro: distinct bundle versus book/origin meanings and readings; shape comparison supported.
N013杯→不 S-intro: distinct cup/counter versus negation meanings and readings; component comparison supported.
N014杯→校 S-intro: distinct cup/counter versus school meanings and readings; shared 木-left shape comparison supported.
N015杯→休 S-intro: distinct cup/counter versus rest meanings and readings; contrasting 木 placement comparison supported.
L001望 SUPPORTED: source and official evidence support the lesson within introductory scope.
L002未 SUPPORTED: source and official evidence support the lesson within introductory scope.
L003末 SUPPORTED: source and official evidence support the lesson within introductory scope.
L004束 SUPPORTED: source and official evidence support the lesson within introductory scope.
L005杯 SUPPORTED: source and official evidence support the lesson within introductory scope.
A001 SUPPORTED-BOUNDED: 望む/願う overlap, full-moon sense, and non-frequency wording are appropriately bounded.
A002 SUPPORTED-BOUNDED: 未- prefix, 未来, 未定, and zodiac sense are appropriately bounded.
A003 SUPPORTED-BOUNDED: 末 period-end examples and suffix/archaic senses are appropriately bounded.
A004 SUPPORTED-BOUNDED: 束, 束ねる, 約束, and secondary senses are appropriately bounded.
A005 SUPPORTED-BOUNDED: 杯, 一杯, 乾杯, and extended counters are appropriately bounded.
NAV01 words/一杯.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 杯 wrapper added; prose, metadata, quiz data, and existing links unchanged.
NAV02 words/約束.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 束 wrapper added; prose, metadata, quiz data, CRLF behavior, and existing links unchanged.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; O002 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; O003 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; O004 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; O005 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD.
Findings: F001 — kanji/望.md, link occurrences in the lesson meaning/examples sections: 望む and 願う are rendered as Markdown links although those Russian word pages are absent from the runtime. Consequence: learners encounter dead navigation. Fix: keep the Japanese words as plain text, or link only if the corresponding Russian runtime files are added under the accepted scope. Evidence: assigned runtime inventory and complete lesson read. Confidence: high. F002 — kanji/未.md, 未来 link in the lesson meaning/examples section: the Russian 未来 page is absent, so the link is dangling. Consequence and fix as F001. Confidence: high. F003 — kanji/末.md, 週末 link in the lesson meaning/examples section: the Russian 週末 page is absent, so the link is dangling. Consequence and fix as F001. Confidence: high.
Optional: The titles are defensible introductory adaptations; no additional confirmed defect.
Limits: Review was bounded to the listed helper windows and current candidate evidence. Ordinary quiz safety was assessed only for the 15 directed pairs and should not be generalized to unlisted pairs. No external dictionary pages were read.
